## Earnie 2.6.0-alpha.10

Community **pre-release** of the **2.6** line. Pin this tag — **no** `:latest`.

### Highlights

- **2.6.p — Absent / holiday mode on all EHAL backends** — plant `sens_absent_mode` live read via Loxone Merker, HA entity (`binary_sensor` / `input_boolean`, …), or OpenEMS `component/Channel`; same HK **OR** plant semantics (Monitor hint, live MILP opt-out, Haus-Wärme absenkung)
- Docs synced for multi-backend absent binding; HA aggregate includes optional binary plant field

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.0-alpha.10` and `:next` (**no** `:latest`) after you approve **promote**
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.3**).

HA add-on: pre-release channel only (`earnie_prerelease`) — official `earnie` is not updated by this tag.
